wake.title: Waking up the services…
wake.body: This demo runs on free hosting, so the backend sleeps when nobody uses it. The first request can take up to a minute. The page will update by itself.

arch.title: How it works
arch.subtitle: Five services, one event stream, no distributed transactions.

saga: Each service reacts to events and publishes the outcome. There is no central orchestrator.
outbox: State changes and their events are committed in the same database transaction, then relayed to Redis.
idempotency: Consumer groups deliver at least once; each service stores processed event ids and ignores duplicates.
compensation: A declined payment triggers inventory to release the reserved units.
gateway: Routing, request ids, rate limiting, a circuit breaker per service and API composition.
sse: The notifications service pushes every event to the browser in real time.
